description: Derived mapping (not part of the native training file). Each native record in planner_gen_sft.jsonl (no ID field) is matched to a gen problem by exact canonical-JSON equality of the [spec] block in the user message vs problem['spec'] in training/gen/problems at commit 787ff95. Records are NOT modified.

method.match_rule: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) equality; unique match required
method.caveat: Current HEAD gen/problems differs for g069, g085, g126 (0c5c95e, 2026-07-10, after training); rebuilding from HEAD does not reproduce the native file.
